metadata.author: V2 expansion (subagent draft)
metadata.key_test: Does a measured 'moderate' P1 OVERSTATE resilience when a confessional elite cartel hollows out institutions? Tests whether the wide P1-P5 pillar spread flags the vulnerability the composite MI masks -- a P1-surprise hard case. Safeguard F (sectarian militias / Hezbollah) and Safeguard H (centrifugal elite-cartel consociationalism).
metadata.notes: Reference-based record: indicators resolved live via mi.datasource. resolved_scores carry MI v2 re-scored pillars (pre 2010, post 2024). P3 missing pre / P4 missing post are real data gaps.

pre_event.event_description: Lebanon before its post-2019 collapse -- a confessional power-sharing (Taif) system measured at a deceptively moderate 2010 baseline, ahead of the worst economic crisis globally since the mid-19th century (World Bank).

context.neighbor_details: Syria war spillover + recurrent Israel-Hezbollah conflict.

Lebanon.notes: Indicators resolved via mi.datasource (Lebanon, 2010 -> 2024). Confessional power-sharing as elite cartel: Safeguard H centrifugal classifier; Hezbollah as armed state-within-state -> Safeguard F. Wide pillar spread is the diagnostic of interest.

a_trajectory_ranking.prediction: Decline; drop from Tier 2 toward Tier 3 as institutions fail.
a_trajectory_ranking.basis: Pre-P1 0.440 is only moderate-low and the wide pillar spread (high P4 capacity vs low P5 cohesion 0.414) signals hidden fragility; predicts deterioration.

b_violence.prediction: Elevated political-violence / instability risk despite the 'moderate' headline P1, driven by sectarian militias.
b_violence.agency_note: Mod8: this predicts RISK, not AGENCY.

d_failure_dimension.prediction: Composite MI/P1 OVERSTATES resilience; the wide P1-P5 spread (P4 0.846 vs P5 0.414, ~0.43) is the true warning. Primary failure surfaces in cohesion (P5) and in the gap between formal capacity and a hollowed elite-cartel institutional core.
d_failure_dimension.note: Most exposed to post-hoc coding bias; this is the case's central hypothesis.
d_failure_dimension.falsification_condition: The moderate 2010 MI correctly tracked resilience (no collapse) / spread did not flag vulnerability.

e_fragment_count.prediction: No formal partition despite confessional cantonization; state stays nominally intact.

f_reversal_risk.prediction: Prolonged institutional paralysis / governance reversal (presidential vacuums, caretaker governments).

g_suppression_mechanism.classification: Elite-cartel consociational (confessional) -- centrifugal capture (Safeguard H), not coercive suppression.
g_suppression_mechanism.falsification_condition: Unity/order maintained by coercive state suppression rather than elite cartel.

h_substate_turbulence.prediction: Sub-state turbulence triggered -- sectarian militias, Hezbollah as armed state-within-state.
h_substate_turbulence.falsification_condition: No armed sub-state actors / no sub-state turbulence.

Lebanon.outcome_summary: P1 0.440->0.324; MI 0.603->0.472 (Tier 2 -> Tier 3). Post-2019 collapse: the lira lost >98% of its pre-crisis value by Feb 2023 (World Bank Lebanon Economic Monitor), sovereign default (2020), banking-sector bankruptcy -- a 'perfect storm' unseen since the 19th century. 2020 Beirut port explosion; 2021 Tayouneh sectarian clashes; presidential vacuum 2022-2024; 2024 Israel-Hezbollah war. P5 cohesion fell 0.414->0.328.

b_violence.evidence: 2021 Tayouneh clashes; Hezbollah armed dominance; 2024 Israel-Hezbollah war; 2020 port explosion.
b_violence.explanation: Elevated instability/violence risk realized despite the moderate headline P1.
b_violence.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28: focus=Lebanon pre-P1=0.440 -> MODERATE risk (MI v1, anchored)

d_failure_dimension.evidence: 2010 MI of 0.603 (Tier 2) preceded a near-total state-economic collapse; the pre-spread (P4 0.846 vs P5 0.414, ~0.43) was the standing warning the composite masked.
d_failure_dimension.explanation: Central hypothesis borne out: the moderate composite overstated resilience and the wide P1-P5 spread flagged the vulnerability. Post-hoc dimension identification coded PARTIAL under strict standards, but the spread-as-warning signal is the case's key finding.
d_failure_dimension.computed_config: Lebanon: P4=0.85, P2=0.71, P1=0.44, P5=0.41 | below-median (genuine vulnerabilities): P5=0.41, P1=0.44

analysis.overall_assessment: P1-surprise hard case largely confirmed: the moderate 2010 composite overstated resilience and the wide pillar spread flagged the hidden fragility that the post-2019 collapse realized.
new_failure_modes_discovered: A moderate composite MI can mask elite-cartel institutional hollowing; the P1-P5 spread (not the level) is the leading indicator of confessional-consociational collapse.
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: Pillar SPREAD outperforms the composite MI level as a vulnerability signal where a confessional elite cartel hollows institutions behind a formally moderate score.
proposed_framework_modifications: Treat a wide P1-P5 spread under power-sharing/elite-cartel contexts as a standing vulnerability flag that down-weights the composite.
analysis.baseline_impact: Spread-flag is additive; not yet implemented; baseline unchanged.
analysis.phase3_note: Migrated to MI v1 + Data API references. a_trajectory/c_convergence auto-derived from real re-scored data (Mod4-gated); b/d/e/f/g/h preserved as judgment.
analysis.judgment_refresh_note: Judgment verdicts (b/d/e/f/g/h) re-examined against MI v1 real-data scores on 2026-06-28: no verdict flips (directional readings robust to the legacy->anchored vintage change); b risk-levels refreshed from real pre-P1, d augmented with the real config (weakest pillar flagged as a binding vulnerability only when below median), safeguards re-evaluated.

data_resolution: Indicators resolved live via mi.datasource (country_ref + year); no embedded copies.

lead_time.method: outcome anchored at 2024; predictor = pre-event P1 at (2024-lead); Mod4 margin + V3 consolidated-pair caution (abstain = correctly cautious, not a miss).
lead_time.note: risk tier shifted within the decade -> a time-sensitive case (acute signal emerges late)
